## Architecture Overview

The `SharedInformer` interface in `k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache` is used by every Kubernetes controller for watching and caching API resources. Adding `WaitForCacheSync(ctx context.Context) bool` requires all implementations and wrappers to add this method. Currently, projects use `cache.WaitForCacheSync()` utility function with `informer.HasSynced` callbacks.

## Detailed Analysis

### ArgoCD

- **`pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go`** — Generated `SharedInformerFactory` with `Start()`, `WaitForCacheSync()`, `Shutdown()`, `InformerFor()`. Manages multiple `cache.SharedIndexInformer`.
- **`server/server.go`** (line 665) — `cache.WaitForCacheSync(ctx.Done(), server.projInformer.HasSynced, server.appInformer.HasSynced, server.clusterInformer.HasSynced)`.
- **`util/settings/cluster_informer.go`** — Custom `ClusterInformer` wrapping `cache.SharedIndexInformer` with transform functions.
- **`controller/appcontroller.go`** — Uses standard informers for deployment watching.

### Cert-Manager

- **`pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go`** — Generated factory with `WaitForCacheSync()` managing Acme/Certmanager informers.
- **`pkg/controller/controller.go`** (line 100) — `cache.WaitForCacheSync(ctx.Done(), c.mustSync...)` with `[]cache.InformerSynced`.
- **`internal/informers/core.go`** (lines 44-77) — Custom `Informer` interface with `AddEventHandler()` and `HasSynced()` subset.

### Prometheus

- **`discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go`** — Creates and manages informers for service discovery with `informer.Run(ctx.Done())`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/pod.go`** (lines 146-154) — Collects `HasSynced` from `podInf`, `nodeInf`, `namespaceInf`, uses `cache.WaitForCacheSync(ctx.Done(), cacheSyncs...)`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/node.go`** (lines 99-102) — `cache.WaitForCacheSync(ctx.Done(), n.informer.HasSynced)`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/endpoints.go`** (lines 255-263) — Aggregates multiple `HasSynced` from different resource types.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/service.go`** (lines 125-130) — Similar WaitForCacheSync pattern.

### OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib

- **`processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/client.go`** (lines 284-408) — Creates separate informers per resource type, `informer.Run(c.stopCh)`, `cache.WaitForCacheSync(timeoutCh, reg.HasSynced)`.
- **`processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/fake_informer.go`** — Fake implementation with `HasSynced()` returning true.

## Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| argo-cd | pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go | Generated SharedInformerFactory |
| argo-cd | server/server.go | WaitForCacheSync with multiple HasSynced |
| argo-cd | util/settings/cluster_informer.go | Custom SharedIndexInformer wrapper |
| argo-cd | controller/appcontroller.go | Standard informer usage |
| cert-manager | pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go | Generated factory with WaitForCacheSync |
| cert-manager | pkg/controller/controller.go | WaitForCacheSync with InformerSynced slice |
| cert-manager | internal/informers/core.go | Custom Informer interface with HasSynced() |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go | Informer creation and management |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/pod.go | WaitForCacheSync with multiple informers |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/node.go | WaitForCacheSync with single informer |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/endpoints.go | Aggregated HasSynced |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/client.go | Multiple informers with WaitForCacheSync |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/fake_informer.go | Fake HasSynced implementation |
